prediction_text: Prediction: Yes — Britain votes to Leave the European Union on 23 June 2016. The Leave side wins the referendum despite February polls showing 'Stay' ahead with many undecideds; the undecided bloc breaks disproportionately to Leave on the day. Uranus–Ceres conjunct at 23° Aries on referendum day is read as the rupture signature over the UK national charts (1066/1801/1922): severance, not continuity. Timing: result known 24 June 2016.
